summary: [spec-fidelity] The policy approval takes its own clock reading. approve_all computes `when` once, but policy_approval::record stamps Utc::now() itself, at second precision. A call that crosses a second boundary gives the policy approved_at a different time from the briefs; F1 says one call writes one time. The .69 test strips approved_at, which hides this. Also: a multi-id refusal always carries the `clear the blockers` hint, even for a missing brief or an open fence. A multi-line --note gives APPROVAL_INCOMPLETE, not BRIEF_APPROVE_REFUSED. Fix: pass `when` into record.
